skill.name: azure-reliability
skill.description: Assess and improve Azure Functions and App Service reliability. Review zone redundancy, storage replication, health probes, and multi-region failover before applying confirmed CLI or IaC changes.
skill.summary: Assess Azure application reliability and guide confirmed remediation through Azure CLI, Bicep, or Terraform.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: All 100 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, relative links, IaC identifiers, Azure endpoint examples, and a C# attribute. The skill intentionally runs Azure CLI and IaC deployments, with scoped operations and explicit confirmation before changes. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

content.user_title: Assess and Improve Azure Application Reliability
content.value_statement: Azure application reliability gaps can remain hidden until a zone or region fails. This skill assesses key controls and guides confirmed Azure CLI or IaC remediation.
actual_capabilities: Discovers Azure Functions and App Service resources within a selected resource group or subscription.
Checks compute zone redundancy, storage replication, health probes, and multi-region failover.
Presents a feature-based reliability table with affected resources and status.
Applies confirmed Azure CLI changes and verifies the resulting resource state.
Patches existing Bicep or Terraform files and guides staged deployments.
Generates confirmed secondary-region and Azure Front Door infrastructure for supported applications.
limitations: Supports Azure Functions and App Service only; Azure Container Apps are not assessed.
Requires Azure authentication and Reader access for assessment.
Configuration changes require Contributor access and explicit user approval.
Provides reliability checks, not complete security, compliance, or deployment validation.

use_cases.title: Audit production reliability
use_cases.description: Assess zone, storage, probe, and regional resilience before an operational review.

use_cases.title: Plan resilient architecture
use_cases.description: Identify single-region dependencies and prepare an Azure Front Door failover design.

use_cases.title: Persist reliability fixes
use_cases.description: Patch Bicep or Terraform settings so reliability changes remain after deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess reliability for Azure resources in [scope]. Show the feature table and explain each gap. Do not make changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a read-only reliability review.

prompt_templates.title: Review one application
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess my [Function App or App Service] in [resource group]. Recommend quick wins, costs, and consent gates. Ask before running any command.
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate a known application and prioritize fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Patch existing infrastructure
prompt_templates.prompt: Patch reliability gaps in my [Bicep or Terraform] project. Show proposed file changes and the deployment plan. Wait for confirmation before deployment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Make reliability settings persistent in infrastructure as code.

prompt_templates.title: Design regional failover
prompt_templates.prompt: Design multi-region failover for [application] using Azure Front Door and [secondary region]. Include health probes, storage replication, costs, validation, and staged deployment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an advanced active-passive reliability architecture.

output_examples.input: Assess the reliability of my Function App resource group without making changes.
output_examples.output: The assessment reports compute zone redundancy as off, storage as LRS, health probes as partial, and multi-region failover as off.

output_examples.input: Create a safe plan to improve zone resilience for my production application.
output_examples.output: The plan enables compute zone redundancy first, verifies it, then requests approval for storage migration. It also lists expected cost and duration.

output_examples.input: Prepare my Terraform project for multi-region failover, but do not deploy.
output_examples.output: The result summarizes proposed secondary-region resources, Azure Front Door routing, health probes, storage replication, affected files, and the confirmation required before deployment.

best_practices: Start with read-only assessment and define the exact subscription or resource group scope.
Review cost, downtime, and replacement risks before approving any configuration change.
Reassess after each deployment and test regional failover on a planned schedule.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad Azure queries without a user-defined scope.
Do not combine slow storage migration with quick compute changes in one deployment.
Do not start multi-region deployment before explicit approval and core reliability checks.

faq.question: Which Azure services are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Azure Functions and Azure App Service. Azure Container Apps support is planned but unavailable.

faq.question: Can it make changes automatically?
faq.answer: It can run confirmed Azure CLI or deployment commands. It must show the plan and receive approval before changes.

faq.question: Which reliability controls are assessed?
faq.answer: It checks compute zone redundancy, storage replication, health probes, and multi-region failover.

faq.question: Does it support infrastructure as code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can patch existing Bicep and Terraform projects for supported reliability settings.

faq.question: What Azure permissions are required?
faq.answer: Reader access supports assessment. Contributor access is required for configuration changes and deployments.

faq.question: Does it replace full deployment validation?
faq.answer: No. It validates reliability concerns only and does not provide complete security, compliance, or application testing.
